# Webull starter kit (vendored, unmodified)

Source: the Systematic Trading track page's "DOWNLOAD KIT .ZIP",
https://www.gqhacks.com/webull/gqh-webull-backtrader-starter.zip (179,372 bytes,
SHA-256 d51695a6d549067216083fa6da0c59e3e0533c1b2a914cca76788cca7db8d08e).

Every file is as shipped in that ZIP except the sample report `examples/backtest/backtest_report_lwc.html`,
left out for size. Nothing here was edited. `scripts/webull_backtest.py` imports this copy (set
`WEBULL_KIT` to use another), so judges need no download to run the kit.
